notesEn: 0.3.62: Speed up pull by ~3.1x (341s -> 109s on a 49k-file workspace with 100k orphan files). Fixes in runtime/apply.ps1: (1) defer per-file backup until a file is actually going to be overwritten (was backing up the whole workspace unconditionally); (2) replace Get-FileHash with .NET SHA256.ComputeHash (~6x faster); (3) fix archive plugin version regex to accept Windows backslash paths in zip (was re-deploying 3 link plugins every pull); (4) replace $extra += array (O(n^2), ~5.1B copies over 100k orphan files) with Generic.List[string].Add. Also repairs historical market-index.json: 0.3.61 entry commit was a TODO placeholder and the plugins structure was malformed; both fixed. projcache is still skipped (context-overflow fix from 0.3.61 preserved).
notes: 0.3.62: 拉取提速约 3.1 倍（49110 文件 + 10 万孤儿文件工作区：341 秒降到 109 秒）。runtime/apply.ps1 修复：(1) 备份延后到文件即将被覆盖时才逐个备份（原来无条件全量备份整个工作区）；(2) Get-FileHash 换成 .NET SHA256.ComputeHash（约快 6 倍）；(3) 修正归档插件版本正则以兼容 zip 里的反斜杠路径（原来每次拉取都重新解压 3 个 link 插件）；(4) $extra += 数组是 O(n²)（10 万孤儿文件约 51 亿次拷贝），换成 Generic.List[string].Add。同时修复历史遗留的 market-index.json：0.3.61 条目 commit 是 TODO 占位符且 plugins 结构损坏，均已修正。0.3.61 的跳过 projcache（上下文超长修复）保持不变。
